prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (RDC, call sign Juniper) intakes EMS requests and preserves incident/coordination/audit evidence under access/retention controls: reports/corrections, pediatric observations, triage basis/timing, assignments, routes/destinations, arrivals/handover, facility constraints, timestamps, communication failures, temporary channels, pending decisions, restrictions/rationale/scope/duration, corrective actions. Aliases: Call Taker Mara=Larkspur; Triage Supervisor=Copperfield; Shift Commander=Sundial; Radio Coordinator=Mistral; Kestrel=capacity/service-limit confirmer. CAD/Computer Aided Dispatch Console uses distance/access/travel/restrictions/weather/closures/demand/capacity/crew readiness/capability/coverage, displays latest confirmed unit status with time/source, and is scenario-tested before regional change authorization. Ambulance Coordination Platform queues updates during interruptions, flags reconciliation, tracks accepted mutual aid separately, is impact-assessed for operational/clinical/security/continuity changes, and monitored for availability/response time/data integrity/interface failures. Release records identify owner, test evidence, limits, rollback. Larkspur enters/updates data, confirms incident/facility, keeps caller connected when feasible. Copperfield assigns priority/response, sends Pediatric Acuity Note to Hospital Liaison Desk, validates surge/prioritization, approves/documents triage override, reviews duplicate audit memo and cases where acuity/escalation timing affected risk. Pediatric concerning findings require escalation; Paramedic Crew reassesses/reports changes and shall not enter uncertain area when instructions unconfirmed. Regional Medical Director sets/reviews clinical guidance, no dispatch authority, may advise prioritization, reviews significant events with Sundial. Hospital Liaison Desk coordinates capacity/destination/acceptance/handover, records facility responses, contributes protected operational observations; Kestrel ensures limits before destination. Emergency Department reports limits/access restrictions. Ambulance Unit 417 reports arrival/handover and post-restoration position/safe status. Fleet Maintenance Cell reports faults, uses Mutual Aid Release Form for accountable maintenance/availability, schedules preventive work by manufacturer/service/requirements; records asset, work, parts, return-to-service. Mistral manages radio/fallbacks, uses South Access Lane Notice in review; Regional Radio Network/interfaces checked after maintenance/configuration. Sundial may restrict risky capability, adjusts deployment, approves exceptions. Audits state records/criteria/limits; material findings get owner/due date/closure verification. RDC cadence reviews thresholds, demand, coverage,

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
